name: delinquency
description: Delinquent tenants (and prospects) with balance owed, one row per tenant, largest first. Built-in Delinquency report.
use: Tenants who owe past due, largest first
answer_hint: Defaults: balance over $100, more than 5 days late, current tenants + prospects, all charge types. Differs from aged_receivables (no prospects, no threshold), so totals will not match it.

property.description: Property name/nickname/ID, comma-separated for several; empty = all

balance_over.description: only accounts owing MORE than this amount (100 = over $100)

days_late_over.description: only accounts MORE than this many days late (5 = more than 5 days)

summary.description: one row per tenant (true) or detail rows per charge (false)

headline: {count} delinquent accounts (current tenants + prospects) owe {sum$:Owed} as of {as_of}; largest: {top1:Tenant} ({top1$:Owed}).
